title: Duck Quest
start: Investigate a strange fishing spot on the riverbank south of Draynor Village.

recommended.t: Activated Draynor, Falador and Varrock lodestones

rewards.t: Access to Paddlington via Monty the rubber duckie or Waddle Willow

steps.t: Head south of the bank in Draynor Village and fish the fishing spot?. [Chat: Accept › Any]
Pick up the nest debris just north of the bridge leading to the Wizards' Tower.

Continue picking it up south east along the coast, east through the swamp, when you reach the graveyard head north past the Lumbridge castle towards Fred the Farmer's house (through Lumbridge market), north over the bridge, then just west near the Waddle Willow tree.
Talk to Breadstix. [Chat: 2 What are you up to at the moment? › 2 What's the language? (Continue Quest)]
Use duck food on a vial of water to make a duckspeak potion.
Talk to Breadstix again.
Drink the potion. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Jemima. [Chat: 3 Okay - I'll start the Inducktion.]
Talk to Invigilatoad. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Eat each of the six peas. They are indicated as red dots on the minimap.
Talk to Invigilatoad again. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Sit down at the relaxing spot at the end of the path to the west.
Talk to Paddlington Badger on the west edge of the sanctuary.
Interact with the floor button on the east side of the sanctuary.
Press the floor button south from Paddlington badger. [Chat: 4 Something might happen?]
Press the floor button on the east side of the sanctuary.
Interact with the tree bud directly north of the east button.
Interact with the toad statue twice.
Talk to duckling's dad or mum.
Quest complete!
